purpose: Teach: 丸太/水色/土手/浜辺/ウロコ/ニオイ/吊り/ハズレ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが丸太のベンチを庭に置いて下さったわよ
lines.en: Sho, your father put that lovely wooden log bench out in the garden for us.
lines.style: Warm, gentle opening. Tender pride in what Ryosuke did. Slow, clear pace — the kind of voice that invites him to share what he thinks. Slight upturn at the end, expecting his response.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに水色のシャツを買って頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad bought me a light blue shirt — it's so nice.
lines.style: Bright, uncomplicated joy. Quick warm attack on the first word. Small boy's clarity — he's telling her something that matters to him. Natural, unpretentious. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが川の土手をお散歩される事が多いわ
lines.en: Sho, your father walks along the river bank quite often these days.
lines.style: Observant, gentle. Quiet wonder beneath the surface — noticing something about Ryosuke without naming it. Unhurried pace. The voice of someone piecing together a small pattern.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと浜辺で貝殻を拾ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I picked up seashells together at the beach.
lines.style: Soft, genuine pride. Not loud — the quiet satisfaction of having done something with his father. Warm, direct gaze in the voice. Slight fadeout on the memory.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「目からウロコが落ちた」って仰ったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said he had a real revelation — scales fell from his eyes, as they say.
lines.style: Reflective, almost musing. Slight wonder in the Japanese phrase. Yumiko savoring the idiom and what it means about Ryosuke's shift. Measured, contemplative pace. Not explaining — observing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「魚のニオイは換気で消える」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me that you can get rid of fish smell just by opening the windows.
lines.style: Earnest, matter-of-fact. Small boy reporting something useful he learned. Warm respect in his voice for the knowledge — not bragging, just proud to know. Even, clear delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが洗濯物の吊り直しをして下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father rehung all the laundry for me — such a help.
lines.style: Gentle, appreciative. Tender attention to the small practical kindness. Soft opening. Quiet gratitude that doesn't perform itself. Slight warmth at the word 'help.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとくじ引きでハズレを引いちゃったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I played a lottery game and I got the losing ticket.
lines.style: Small wry laugh beneath the words — the gentle deflation of it, but also the companionship in losing together. Not complaining. Self-aware 6-year-old humor. Slight resignation, mostly warmth.
